review_notes: I read the whole target file. I also read the definitions of orderedPairSum, overlapPair, nearPair, farPair and overlapPair_split in RectanglePairEnergy.lean, and the parallel near-pair proofs in NearPairEnergy.lean and SelectedCountingEnergy.lean. I found no simp attributes in the target and no loop risk. The only issue is the missing simp interface for the pair definitions. The target never marks its own `he` or `hit` facts simp, so I did not flag those. The proposed lemma names are suggestions that I have not compiled, and the exact shape of the `Classical` decidability instance may need care when stating them. orderedPairSum unfolds fine by its equation lemmas, so I made no finding about it.

findings.problem: farPair and overlapPair are plain defs with no simp-oriented interface. These include a guard-true/guard-false evaluation lemma for farPair and `overlapPair_comm`. The proof of `he` therefore does case splits and unfolds both definitions at every use (`simp only [farPair,ite_eq_left hf,ite_eq_left hboth,overlapPair]`, `simp [farPair,hf,overlapPair,hz]`, `simp [farPair,hf]`). Unfolding `overlapPair` exposes `volume (_ ∩ _)`, which is not the normal form downstream lemmas use. The same unfolding and the same `inter_comm` fix are repeated by hand elsewhere: `unfold nearPair overlapPair; rw [inter_comm ...]` in near_previous_sum, `hsym` in list_overlap_energy, and `hdiag := by simp [overlapPair]`. Each proof is brittle, because it depends on the exact unfolded form of the definitions, and the facts are not available to `simp` in later files.
findings.proposed_change: In RectanglePairEnergy.lean, add equation lemmas with these statements (the names are suggestions): `farPair_of_lt (h : 64*(R j).short < (R j).long*dist ((R i).axes 0) ((R j).axes 0)) : farPair R i j = overlapPair R i j`; `farPair_of_not_lt (h : ¬ …) : farPair R i j = 0`; the matching pair `nearPair_of_le` and `nearPair_of_not_le`; `overlapPair_comm : overlapPair R i j = overlapPair R j i` (by `inter_comm`); and `overlapPair_self : overlapPair R i i = volume (R i).carrier`. Mark the last two `@[simp]`, or at least `@[simp]` the guarded rewrites, which have hypotheses discharged by simp. The proof of `he` then becomes `Finset.sum_filter`, `Finset.sum_congr`, a split on the guard with `farPair_of_lt` or `farPair_of_not_lt`, and `overlapPair_comm`. The empty-intersection branch becomes a single lemma, for example `overlapPair R r j = 0` when `¬ ((R r).carrier ∩ (R j).carrier).Nonempty`. None of these lemmas can loop.
findings.benefit: The defs stay opaque, so simp goals read `farPair R i j` and `overlapPair R i j` instead of `if … then volume (… ∩ …) else 0`. Callers can discharge the guard hypothesis with `simp [hf]` or `simp [farPair_of_lt hf]` rather than unfolding. The ad-hoc `inter_comm` and diagonal proofs in this file, NearPairEnergy.lean and RectanglePairEnergy.lean share one canonical commutativity and diagonal lemma. Later files that sum these quantities, such as SelectedCountingEnergy.lean, get a stable rewrite interface.
